paragraphs: A dispensation and a ministry are different kinds of period. Bahá’u’lláh’s earthly ministry ended with His passing in 1892, while His dispensation continues.

The Kitáb-i-Aqdas, note 62, anchors the thousand-year minimum to October 1852. The 1853 chapter boundary in God Passes By describes a historical division and is not used here as the beginning of that minimum.
